rows.explanation: RECONSTRUCT SOUTH MIDDLE VILLAGE STREETS (HWQ 708) This long awaited project had been scheduled for FY 2013, but has been pushed back, but we must continue to advocate for the project to be moved up. As a short term measure, 73rd Place was resurfaced from Metropolitan Ave to 70 Ave., as were several other area roadways. This areawide project will include replacement of water mains, sewer lines, sidewalks, curbs, street lighting and roadway reconstruction of all streets bordered by Metropolitan Ave to the north, the LIRR and Cooper Ave. No. Service Rd to the South, 80 Street to the east and 73 Place to the west, not including Metropolitan Ave & 80 Street.

rows.claim: Published request and agency response; not an appropriation or solicitation.
rows.explanation: The vendor Circuit needs funding to initiate a pilot program to provide free or low-cost electric vehicle shuttle services in CB6. A large number of CB6 residents rely on their personal vehicles for transportation, which not only increases the chances they will leave the district to spend their money but also increases traffic congestion and pollution in our district. We hope that by having DOT provide funding for this program we'll be able to both alleviate traffic congestion and decrease pollution in our community.
rows.headline: Address traffic congestion
rows.response: OMB supports the agency's position as follows: Agency does not support and cannot accommodate Explanation: NYC DOT initiated a Carshare program. More info here: https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/motorist/carshare.shtml DOT will continue to explore the Circuit business and service model, however we cannot commit to providing any funding.
